title.narrative: Preparation of a feasibility study for an industrial park at Ibigwe field in Imo State, Nigeria

description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to support Waltersmith Petroman Oil Ltd with the development of an industrial park at Ibigwe field in Imo State of Nigeria, which will serve to create a value chain for petroleum in Nigeria, a country known for exporting most of its crude oil and importing downstream products for the domestic market. The project will prepare a conceptual feasibility study for the industrial park in line with the step-wise approach presented in UNIDO#s recently published #International Guidelines for Industrial Parks#. Prior to partnering with Waltersmith, UNIDO, subject to UNIDO Policy on Business Sector Partnerships (DGB/2017/17), conducted a compulsory due diligence exercise in June 2020, clearing the way for further engagement. WalterSmith has acquired 65 ha of land for the industrial park, which hosts a recently inaugurated refinery with a capacity of 5,000 barrels/day. Waltersmith has launched the expansion of the refinery and targets a processing capacity of 50,000 b/p of refined oil products, i.e. kerosene, diesel, petrol and jet fuel, which will pave way for other petrochemical industries to establish at the proposed industrial park.
